content.short: Swapped.com enables companies to buy and sell cryptocurrency using 30+ local payment methods.
content.description: Swapped.com lets businesses buy and sell cryptocurrency using local payment methods, rather than relying on credit cards. With access to 30+ payment options, the platform accommodates a range of projects and regional requirements. By enabling alternative payments, it helps bridge financial gaps worldwide and expands crypto adoption in underserved markets, supporting broader inclusion in the digital asset economy and beyond.
